The surname *Sylvester* (and its variants) is derived from the Latin adjective **silvestris** (“wooded, forest‑ed,” from *silva* “forest”). Charlemagne’s reign was a time when Latin was the lingua franca of the Empire, so the name’s roots are firmly Latin.
